main_measure.name: t of mean of (excess 3-bar return x forecast/10) over Sunday cases
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 over at least 100 cases (confirm, with slope > 0); t <= -2 over at least 100 cases (reject)

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 3-bar return on forecast > 0

decided_by: Confirm: t >= 2 over at least 100 cases and the slope of excess return on forecast is above 0.
reading: A Sunday bar is one whose UTC start timestamp is a Sunday (its next bar is a Monday); the coin's mean 3-bar return is pooled over non-overlapping 3-bar stretches of all its windows; cases whose 3-bar return would leave the window are dropped; the minimum of 100 cases gives 'not observable' when unmet.
